title: Unified investigation context sharing between agents
description: Create a shared investigation context store that persists across agent conversations. Currently each NEXUS agent session starts from scratch — investigators lose accumulated evidence and insights when switching agents.
painPointsAddressed: Investigators repeat themselves to each agent
estimatedImpact: Eliminates 60% of repeated context-setting in multi-agent workflows. Enables true collaborative investigation across specialist agents.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts for Terminal navigation
description: Implement Ctrl+K command palette and Ctrl+L clear, Ctrl+R history search in the custom terminal. Currently the terminal only supports basic text input — power users need vim-style navigation.
painPointsAddressed: Power users must use mouse for everything
estimatedImpact: Reduces terminal interaction time by 40% for experienced users. Matches expected behavior from real terminal emulators.

title: Real-time scan progress WebSocket integration
description: Replace polling-based scan status updates with WebSocket connections for Atropos Scanner and SpiderFoot. Users currently see delayed results and miss live module completions.
estimatedImpact: Reduces scan result latency from 5s polling to <100ms real-time. Cuts server load from scan status endpoints by 80%.
